```diff
  use tempfile::Builder as TempFileBuilder;
  use tracing::{error, info, warn}; // Import tracing macros // Add the TTS import
+ use clap::{Arg, ArgMatches, Command};
+ use std::path::PathBuf;
  
  /// DEPRECATED: Configuration file name - now using unified settings
  const DEPRECATED_CONFIG_FILE: &str = "config.json";
+ 
+ const CONFIG_FILE: &str = "config.json";
+ 
+ pub fn create_cli() -> Command {
+     Command::new("juno")
+         .version("1.0.0")
+         .about("Juno AI Computer Use Agent")
+         .arg(
+             Arg::new("config")
+                 .short('c')
+                 .long("config")
+                 .value_name("FILE")
+                 .help("Sets a custom config file")
+         )
+         .arg(
+             Arg::new("verbose")
+                 .short('v')
+                 .long("verbose")
+                 .action(clap::ArgAction::Count)
+                 .help("Increase verbosity")
+         )
+         .subcommand(
+             Command::new("config")
+                 .about("Configuration management")
+                 .subcommand(
+                     Command::new("show")
+                         .about("Show current configuration file location")
+                 )
+                 .subcommand(
+                     Command::new("init")
+                         .about("Initialize configuration with defaults")
+                 )
+         )
+ }
+ 
+ pub fn handle_cli_args(matches: &ArgMatches) -> Result<(), String> {
+     if let Some(config_matches) = matches.subcommand_matches("config") {
+         if config_matches.subcommand_matches("show").is_some() {
+             show_config_file()?;
+         } else if config_matches.subcommand_matches("init").is_some() {
+             init_config()?;
+         }
+     }
+ 
+     if let Some(config_path) = matches.get_one::<String>("config") {
+         info!("Using custom config file: {}", config_path);
+         // The unified settings system handles configuration automatically
+         // Custom config paths can be implemented if needed
+     }
+ 
+     let verbosity = matches.get_count("verbose");
+     if verbosity > 0 {
+         info!("Verbosity level: {}", verbosity);
+     }
+ 
+     Ok(())
+ }
+ 
+ fn show_config_file() -> Result<(), String> {
+     info!("Configuration is managed through the unified settings system");
+     info!("Settings are stored in the application data directory");
+     info!("Use the application UI to modify settings");
+     Ok(())
+ }
+ 
+ fn init_config() -> Result<(), String> {
+     info!("Configuration initialization is handled automatically by the unified settings system");
+     info!("Default settings are applied on first run");
+     Ok(())
+ }
  
  /// Handles the execution of commands specified via CLI arguments.
```

```diff
+         assert!(matches.is_ok());
+     }
+ 
+     #[test]
+     fn test_verbose_flag() {
+         let cli = create_cli();
+         let matches = cli.try_get_matches_from(vec!["juno", "-vvv"]);
+         assert!(matches.is_ok());
+         if let Ok(matches) = matches {
+             assert_eq!(matches.get_count("verbose"), 3);
+         }
+     }
+ 
+     #[test]
+     fn test_config_file_arg() {
+         let cli = create_cli();
+         let matches = cli.try_get_matches_from(vec!["juno", "--config", "custom.json"]);
+         assert!(matches.is_ok());
+         if let Ok(matches) = matches {
+             assert_eq!(matches.get_one::<String>("config"), Some(&"custom.json".to_string()));
+         }
+     }
```

```diff
          info!("Saved cloud configuration to unified settings");
```
